title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to build and maintain secure, reliable, and scalable cloud platform infrastructure on AWS using modern Infrastructure as Code and container orchestration.
responsibilities: Manage and scale multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS.
Provision and standardize cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Ansible.
Build automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions.
Establish end-to-end monitoring, alerting, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana.
requirements: 4+ years experience managing production AWS environments and Linux systems.
Deep expertise with Docker containerization and Kubernetes orchestration.
Proficiency with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience building CI/CD pipelines and monitoring production distributed systems.
